_comment: Maps ROM file extensions to a system. 'core' is the libretro buildbot core name (cores/fetch_cores.sh <core>). When an extension belongs to several systems, the one whose 'folders' contains the ROM's folder name wins, else the first listed. 'external' systems have no bundled core: the game app launches an installed emulator app instead (on-device converter only). 'bios' lists optional BIOS file names (relative to the core's system folder) that the on-device converter bundles when it finds them in a bios folder. An external emulator with "uri": "path" gets the plain file path instead of a content:// URI (NetherSX2 checks the file exists by path). 'publicCore' replaces a non-commercially licensed core with a GPL-compatible one in the public (distributable) build of the converter: ./raineywrapper converter --public. A 'bios' entry may end in '*.bin' (any matching file is accepted, e.g. PS2 BIOS dumps have model-specific names); 'biosRequired' means the game can't start without one. Files named '*.xiso.iso' are treated as extension 'xiso' (Xbox), wherever they are.
